One quick note on the refresher: it isn't $50. The refresher is booked as the *Dive Mini Course*, and the price depends on where you start from:

- *From Cartagena:* 183 USD online (204 USD regular) — includes boat Cartagena–Islands–Cartagena and lunch.
- *Already on the Rosario Islands:* 134 USD online (149 USD regular) — no lunch, hotel pick-up if your hotel has boat access.

Since you'll be staying on the island, the "already on the islands" option is the one that fits — and it's booked through the same link as the mini course:

👉 https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

There you pick the date (the day before your referral course) and the number of people, and pay online with the 10% discount already applied. The system closes at 4:30 PM the day before, so just book before then.
